Text: "The iPhone 12 won’t come with earphones and a charging adapter."
Claim date: October 14, 2020
before_justification: The fact-check confirms that Apple officially announced during its iPhone 12 launch event on October 13, 2020, that all four iPhone 12 models would exclude earphones and a charging adapter from the box, a policy applied uniformly across global markets. This was reported by multiple credible sources, with Apple's VP of environment citing environmental benefits as the reason.
after_justification: The fact-check confirms that Apple officially announced the removal of EarPods and the USB power adapter from the iPhone 12 packaging, citing [environmental reasons](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sciencetech/article-8840611/Apple-customers-outraged-learning-799-iPhone-12-NOT-include-charger-EarPods.html) such as reducing carbon emissions and mining waste. This change applied universally to [all iPhone 12 models](https://www.mensxp.com/technology/hacks/81011-iphone-12-box-wont-have-earphones.html) sold [worldwide](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sciencetech/article-8840611/Apple-customers-outraged-learning-799-iPhone-12-NOT-include-charger-EarPods.html) starting with the [October 2020 launch](https://www.cnet.com/tech/mobile/samsung-beats-apple-charger-in-the-box-galaxy-note-20-vs-iphone-12-rumor/), though the box still included a [USB-C to Lightning cable](https://www.cnet.com/tech/mobile/samsung-beats-apple-charger-in-the-box-galaxy-note-20-vs-iphone-12-rumor/). Evidence from multiple sources consistently supports this.
